about.en: Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc. is a US professional services firm operating in risk, strategy and people through four businesses: Marsh in insurance broking, Guy Carpenter in reinsurance, Mercer in health, wealth and career advice, and Oliver Wyman in management consulting. The company moved to the Marsh brand in January 2026 and its NYSE ticker changed from MMC to MRSH on 14 January 2026, with the legal name unchanged; in derivative markets MRSH is the reference equity for products tracking its shares.
